integrity: The critical-point existence signs are checked by exact-rational interval arithmetic in the embedded standalone verifier. The Hessian nondegeneracy and Morse-theoretic comparison are proved analytically. Independent audit and independent validation have not been performed.
scientific_limitations: The result proves a lower bound of twenty nondegenerate critical points for one explicit five-circle radius tuple; it is not an exhaustive census and does not classify other radius tuples.
title: Five concentric circles with at least twenty nondegenerate area critical points
